text:
Alex Li: Thanks everyone for coming to today's all-hands. Quick follow-up — dropping a short list of clarifications and owners. Please ack and add estimates where relevant.

Sarah K: Ack. For the Dedicated SLA wording, we should avoid the phrase 'guaranteed latency' — suggest 'target latency' + availability SLA. I can draft suggested language by EOW.

Ben Ortega: I'll own the rollout runbook for Dedicated v2 pools. Will sync with infra and add canary steps. Creating ticket `INF-4321` now.

Maria Chen: On the Private/on‑prem packaging timeline: MVP target end of Q2 but need legal export-control and KMS integration signoffs. I'll coordinate and post an updated timeline in the doc.

Priya R: I'll own evals and quality guardrails for the rollout. Need canonical prompt sets from Product for chat, embeddings, and reranking. @Alex Li can you confirm priority areas?

Alex Li: @Priya R prioritize: 1) chat-generation, 2) embeddings, 3) reranking. Use the `redwood/evals` repo template and pin to model versions for canary tests.

Sarah K: Draft SLA text for review (first pass): "Target P95 latency < 250ms for single-request generation paths; Availability 99.9% for Dedicated pools. Precise terms in contract." Thoughts?

Ben Ortega: Looks good. I'll add automated fallback policy and a rollback checklist to `INF-4321`. Also planning a DR run in staging next week.

eng-bot: Recording uploaded — https://redwood.zoom.us/rec/share/abcd1234  Slides: https://drive.redwood.com/all-hands/mar-2026 (access: redwood-internal)

Priya R: Quick Q: Are model catalog updates locked during rollouts? I need to know whether evals run against pinned versions or latest.

Alex Li: Good question. We pin model versions for canaries. Production switches only after canary success and manual approval. I'll add exact policy text to the rollout doc later today.

Maria Chen: Legal question: do we need extra NDAs or data agreements for Private deployments in the EU beyond our current templates? @People Ops / Legal — pinging for follow-up.

Sarah K: I can sync with Legal and People Ops tomorrow 10am PT and report back here.

Alex Li: Action recap: Ben — rollout runbook & INF-4321 (add canary + rollback steps); Maria — on‑prem timeline & legal coord; Priya — eval suites & prompt sets; Sarah — SLA wording & legal sync. Please add estimated hours to your ticket or comment in this thread by EOD Monday.

Ben Ortega: Ack :thumbsup:

Priya R: Ack

Maria Chen: Ack

Sarah K: Ack

Alex Li: Thanks — if anything else pops up, add to this thread or DM the owner. Will close the follow-up in 48h if no more asks.
